ShortDescription.Value: Inspect local save packages and create restore points or separate restored copies. Recovery is not guaranteed.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — use copies for recovery testing.
WHAT IT DOES Lists local saves and restore points and checks basic package readability.
HOW TO USE Open SaveGuard, select a save, then create a restore point or use Restore As Copy. A restored copy has a separate filename; Restore As Copy does not overwrite its source.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS A readable archive is not proof CS2 can load it. The recovery check reads archive entries; only loading the restored copy verifies recovery. Retention removes older restore points after a new copy succeeds. SaveGuard cannot guarantee recovery from missing mods, incompatible saves or damaged data. Keep independent backups.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.2.4-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Create the new restore point before pruning older ones. Preserve original filenames and avoid destination collisions. Fixed missing selection handling and corrected archive-health wording and settings registration.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
